guidelines.content: Use Python PIL/Pillow for image metadata extraction in sandboxed environments
guidelines.rationale: System tools like exiftool may not be available; PIL is always installable via pip
guidelines.trigger: When extracting image metadata in containerized or sandboxed environments

guidelines.content: Implement batch processing with context managers for large file operations
guidelines.rationale: Prevents memory leaks and ensures proper resource cleanup
guidelines.trigger: When processing files larger than available memory

guidelines.content: Check for existing lock files before choosing a package manager
guidelines.rationale: Projects may already have yarn.lock or package-lock.json indicating preferred tooling
guidelines.trigger: When installing dependencies in an unfamiliar project

guidelines.content: Write outputs to user-writable directories (~/Documents, /tmp, or project-local paths)
guidelines.rationale: System directories often require elevated permissions; user directories are always accessible
guidelines.trigger: When generating output files in any environment

guidelines.content: Validate file paths and permissions before batch processing operations
guidelines.rationale: Early validation prevents partial processing failures mid-operation
guidelines.trigger: When processing multiple files in a pipeline
